name: Inkleaf
description: Warm ink on cream paper, a text serif for headings and a quiet sans for the rest, almost no color. Hand-drawn ink pictograms redrawn at 12 fps and pastel stages carry the voice. Suits calm products, tools and publications.

provenance.notes: Derived design language; no logo, wordmark, mark, copy, artwork, animation files or palette names carried over. Proprietary serif, sans and mono replaced with Source Serif 4, Instrument Sans and JetBrains Mono (all SIL OFL 1.1). Pictograms are a construction recipe for original subjects; the status glyph is an original written-loop design. Derived, not observed: form validation, toasts, dialogs layout, dense tables and dashboards, empty/error/loading states, dark stage colors, status colors other than error, the darker tertiary text (contrast).
